reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and holiday adjustment helpers, but independently implements daily skip-versus-move policy in multiple consumers.

duplication.why: Daily scheduling policy is repeated across getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange, and the budget template's movesWeekend dispatch.

placement.why: Holiday matching belongs appropriately in shared/schedules.ts, but scheduling policy also spreads into server handlers and budget orchestration.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the requested scheduling changes, their configuration, tests, and release notes.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate several implementations of occurrence policy and separate lookahead formulas, while the new handler leaves config untyped despite the existing RecurConfig type.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts: getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange enumerate raw occurrences and independently decide daily skipping versus adjustment instead of sharing the occurrence policy implemented in shared/schedules.ts:getNextDate.

disguised_duplication.where: The same skip-versus-move decision appears as filtering and mapping in getUpcomingDates, a loop with continue in getDatesInRange, and the inverse movesWeekend predicate in schedule-template.ts.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains holidays; getNextDate gains daily filtering and daily-specific exhaustion handling; getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange independently implement the occurrence policy.
